verdict.rationale: MX runs one recurring job itself: it automatically re-aggregates each member about every 24 hours [mx-docs-25]. Webhooks can push the resulting events to your endpoint [mx-docs-7, mx-docs-41], so you can build downstream workflows on a fixed recurring refresh. There is no evidence that users can define their own schedules or recurring workflows. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduling (cron or intervals), custom recurring workflow definitions, control over refresh frequency, independent corroboration.
